description: Synthetic 400 m x 200 m domain that resolves to a 1x2 grid of ten-acre (201.168 m) cells at the canopy_inventory_fuelcalc resolution: west cell holds FuelCalc tutorial plot 1, east cell holds plot 2. The lattice anchors at the lower-left and covers the bounds via ceil, so 400 m x 200 m yields exactly two 201.168 m cells spanning 720000-720402.336. Ten-acre cells match fastfuels-core's FuelCalc comparison so per-acre expansion factors become whole stems exactly.
name: FuelCalc Tutorial Two-Plot
